usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/messages with JSON body {model, max_tokens, messages:[{role,content}]} (Anthropic Messages shape)
usage.outputShape: body.content[0].text (assistant text); token usage at body.usage.input_tokens / body.usage.output_tokens; resolved model at body.model. Native Anthropic Messages response shape.
quirks: This /api/v1/messages endpoint uses the ANTHROPIC Messages shape, not OpenAI chat-completions: required fields are model, max_tokens, and messages — max_tokens is REQUIRED. The result text is at body.content[0].text (array of content blocks), NOT body.choices[0].message.content.
'model' must be a router enum ID like anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5; the response body.model echoes the resolved upstream model (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001).
Pricing is token-based/dynamic; $0.001 is the floor. Use a cheap model + small max_tokens to control cost.
x402 USDC on Base, no API key/account. Must be POST (GET will not work).
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/messages with a JSON body in Anthropic Messages format: {"model":"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5","max_tokens":16,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}. max_tokens is required. Pay via x402 USDC on Base; no API key needed. Read the assistant reply at body.content[0].text and token usage at body.usage. Cost is dynamic/token-based (min ~$0.001), so keep prompts short and max_tokens small. Note this is the Anthropic-shaped sibling of BlockRun's OpenAI chat-completions endpoint — different request/response shape.
